Two iOS crash reports from the owner on 10-15/16.

1) "The iOS app keeps crashing" / "now refuses to start just keeps crashing". Apple diagnostics showed v0.1.11 0x8BADF00D and signal 6 in WebKit. Cause: Previews.swift built an unreachable https://outpost.bewinxed.com:3459 preview URL. I deleted preview instance 23cb5219 and delegated "Fix the iOS preview crash loop" (tsk-17, item 01960ff3). Later, 0ecf4bf8's ios-chat-opens and ios-caw-thread passed (ios-caw-thread on the Mac, 685s). The memory does not show the preview-URL fix itself landing.

2) "Another ios crash when approving sth". Crash 5e7ba196f35b55c6 was TranscriptView.frame(_:) (TranscriptView.swift:1332) from DisplayTarget.tick, on build 20261015.3, a 0x8BADF00D watchdog / SIGBUS. I handed 0ecf4bf8 the fix and an approve-while-streaming test case. Crash fix 2a74e9fa6 is on main but not yet in TestFlight. The TestFlight build waits on the task-sheet fixes (23e62015), and I will check the approval crash on that build.
